title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)
zh_title: AURA：自体免疫病预测模型的随机实用性评估
summary: 将可解释的ANA阳性自体免疫病预测模型嵌入电子病历，在单中心开展为期2年的随机实用性研究，评估其对诊断时点的影响。
key_points: 模型预测ANA阳性者发生系统性自身免疫病
1:1随机，干预组高危者加速风湿科评估
单中心学术医疗系统，随访2年
reason: 前瞻随机实用性设计评估诊断时点结局，非仅准确率，但为单中心，属重要档
abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】对于抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性的个体，目前尚无基于证据的指导来分诊其风湿科转诊。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测哪些新发ANA阳性检测的个体会发生系统性自身免疫病，并在一项为期2年的随机实用性研究中评估了其对自身免疫病诊断时间的影响。【方法】该模型被整合到单一学术医疗系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有ANA阳性个体均按1:1随机分配，且分配与风险评分无关。在干预组中，高风险评分的个体被邀请接受加速的风湿科评估。在对照组中，计算风险评分但不据此采取行动。所有参与者均接受标准诊疗，并可被转诊至风湿科。每6个月进行一次病历审查，评估患者是否接受过风湿科评估以及是否获得自身免疫病诊断。主要结局为从ANA阳性检测到诊断的时间，采用Cox比例风险模型分析。在ANA阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较了各研究组之间被诊断为自身免疫病的比例。【结果】在2385名随机分配的个体中，随机化后排除后，干预组有954人、对照组有1006人被纳入分析。干预组个体自ANA阳性之日起至自身免疫病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比1.9；95%置信区间1.3至2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为43天，对照组为138天。在ANA阳性检测后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组23%、对照组16%被诊断为自身免疫病（P=0.07）。【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入临床预测模型的干预与自身免疫病诊断时间显著缩短相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: A gait foundation model for prediction of multisystem health phenotypes from 3D skeletal motion
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 3D骨骼运动步态基础模型预测多系统健康表型
summary: 基于3328名深度表型成人的单深度相机3D骨骼运动数据，构建步态基础模型预测覆盖18个身体系统的健康表型。
key_points: 3328名深度表型成人，5项运动任务
学习嵌入优于人工步态特征
覆盖握力、睡眠等18个身体系统
reason: Nature Medicine发表，大样本基础模型覆盖18系统，但外部验证未明确，属重要档下限
abstract: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. Here we developed a gait foundation model for three-dimensional skeletal motion, which was recorded via a single-depth camera during 5 motor tasks, from 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults. Our purpose was to capture the full pattern of a person’s movement and use it to predict health phenotypes such as grip strength and sleep quality across 18 body systems. Gait is conventionally described by engineered features (for example, calculated measurements such as cadence and stride length), which may fail to capture the fine detail of how a person moves. Our model instead translates movement into learned embeddings: sets of numbers that describe how all body joints move together over time. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features for prediction of age (Pearsonʼs r = 0.69), body mass index (r = 0.91) and visceral adipose tissue area (r = 0.83), and embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 tested phenotypes. Relative to a baseline model using age, body mass index, visceral adipose tissue and height alone, gait embeddings improved prediction in all 18 systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, as well as prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation analyses revealed that leg dynamics dominated metabolic and frailty predictions, and torso dynamics encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent, multisystem biosignal, motivating integration of gait analysis into routine clinical assessment as a scalable, passive vital sign.
zh_abstract: 步态正日益被视为一种生命体征，然而当前的方法将其视为特定病理的症状，而非系统性生物标志物。在此，我们开发了一个用于三维骨骼运动数据的步态基础模型；该数据通过单深度相机在5项运动任务中采集自3,328名深度表型化的成年人。我们的目的是捕捉一个人运动的完整模式，并用其预测跨越18个身体系统的健康表型，如握力和睡眠质量。步态通常由工程化特征（例如，计算得到的步频和步长等测量值）描述，这些特征可能无法捕捉一个人如何运动的细微细节。我们的模型则将运动转换为学习到的嵌入（learned embeddings）：即描述所有身体关节随时间如何协同运动的一组数字。学习到的嵌入在预测年龄（Pearson r = 0.69）、体质指数（r = 0.91）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.83）方面优于工程化特征，且嵌入显著预测了3,210个受测表型中的1,887个。相对于仅使用年龄、体质指数、内脏脂肪组织和身高的基线模型，步态嵌入改善了男性全部18个系统和女性18个系统中17个系统的预测，以及对临床诊断和药物使用的预测。解剖学消融分析显示，腿部动力学在代谢和衰弱预测中占主导，而躯干动力学编码了睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的多系统生物信号，推动将步态分析作为一种可扩展的、被动的生命体征整合到常规临床评估中。

title: AI-driven multi-horizon risk stratification for heart failure hospitalization in UA with HFpEF: a Chinese multi-center cohort study
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 多中心AI模型预测HFpEF合并UA患者心衰住院风险
summary: 中国多中心4367例不稳定型心绞痛合并HFpEF患者，用集成特征选择与12种机器学习模型预测12/24/36个月心衰住院风险并外部验证。
key_points: 多中心回顾性队列纳入4367例患者
外部验证AUC约0.836–0.839
预测12、24、36个月心衰住院风险
reason: 多中心大样本且报告外部验证，但为回顾性研究，属重要档下限
abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性疾病管理中的一大挑战，其复发性心力衰竭住院（HFH）风险高；尽管已有多个中心的真实世界数据可用，用于多时间跨度风险评估的AI驱动工具仍然有限。本多中心回顾性队列纳入了4367例UA合并HFpEF患者，一个整合LASSO、SVM-RFE和Boruta的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健的预测因子，随后训练了十二种机器学习算法以估计12、24和36个月时间跨度的HFH风险，并进行了外部验证。最优的时间特异模型（ET、GBDT和LightGBM）在训练队列中表现出较强的区分能力，AUC分别为0.818、0.834和0.863，并在外部验证中保持性能，AUC分别为0.839、0.836和0.851；SHAP分析突出显示糖尿病、TyG-BMI和NT-proBNP是最有影响力的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了用于UA合并HFpEF患者HFH风险分层的时间多点机器学习框架，其显示出可接受的校准度，并在决策曲线分析中显示出潜在的临床实用性。尚需在不同人群和医疗系统中开展进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认临床有效性并支持其转化为常规实践。

title: Physical Limits to AI Substitution across Physician Specialties — Implications for the Physician Workforce
zh_title: AI替代医师的物理极限：各专科差异分析
summary: 基于2023年Medicare Part B约450亿美元账单，量化各专科中需当面操作、当前AI无法替代的工作占比。
key_points: 分析56个专科、58.9万名医师的账单数据
按每项服务是否需身体接触分类
需动手操作占比随毕业后培训年限上升
reason: 大样本医保数据分析，但非AI模型或临床结局验证，属值得一看档
abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.
zh_abstract: 摘要：AI 已经能够解读医学图像、起草诊断评估并与患者对话——这助长了其将取代医生的预测。然而，软件无法对患者进行体格检查、活检或手术，因此某一专科工作中需要面对面身体交互的部分，为 AI 单独所能替代的比例设定了上限。通过分析 2023 年 Medicare Part B 索赔——向 56 个专科的 589,648 名医生支付的近 450 亿美元——我们根据每项计费服务是否需要身体接触进行分类，并将评估与管理（E&M）就诊排除在外。非 E&M 工作中属于体力性、因而目前免受 AI 替代的工作占比，在不同专科之间差异很大，并随研究生培训时长增加而上升：皮肤科和骨科手术等操作型领域在很大程度上受到保护。所有支付中仅约五分之一流向没有身体屏障、可被 AI 替代的非 E&M 服务。然而，医生集中于 E&M 占比较高的专科——家庭医学和内科——按我们的衡量，这些专科的物理保护较低。因此，作为职业路径最易进入、也最需要用来缓解初级保健短缺的领域面临最大的不确定性，因为 AI 可能以替代或补充的方式影响其工作——这一结果既取决于 AI 的设计、部署和报销方式，也取决于技术本身。

title: A statistical framework for evaluating the repeatability and reproducibility of large language models.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 量化大模型可重复性与再现性的统计框架
summary: JAMIA 提出通用统计框架与Python包llmReproScore，从语义与内部两维度量化大语言模型输出的可重复性与再现性。
key_points: 建立四个指标，分语义与内部两维度
发布配套Python包llmReproScore
以USMLE题目测试多模型诊断推理输出
reason: 同行评审的评测方法学工作并公开工具包，应用示例有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Systematic evaluation of variability in large language model (LLM)-generated outputs is critical for assessing their reliability. We developed a general statistical framework and Python package (llmReproScore) for quantifying the repeatability and reproducibility of LLM outputs. Following US Food and Drug Administration terminology, our framework establishes four metrics for quantifying LLM repeatability and reproducibility along two dimensions: semantic and internal. Semantic metrics quantify variability in the meaning of LLM-generated outputs, whereas internal metrics quantify variability in token-generation certainty. We validated these metrics, and as an illustrative use case, applied them to diagnostic reasoning outputs generated across LLMs and prompting strategies using US Medical Licensing Examination questions and 90 real-world rare disease cases from the Undiagnosed Diseases Network. Validation results showed that semantic scores aligned with human ratings (Spearman ρ = 0.88 for repeatability and 0.66 for reproducibility) and confirmed that internal metrics capture variability in token-generation certainty. In the illustrative use case, LLM repeatability was generally not associated with accuracy, suggesting that LLM output variability and accuracy capture distinct dimensions of model performance. The proposed metrics can be used to characterize LLM output variability and systematically compare models, prompts, and generation settings. These comparisons can inform more rigorous selection of LLM configurations based on repeatability and reproducibility. We developed and validated generalizable metrics for quantifying LLM output variability. The proposed metrics can complement accuracy-based evaluation to inform experimental design and support more rigorous comparison and selection of models, prompts, and generation settings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 系统评估大语言模型（LLM）生成输出的变异性对于评估其可靠性至关重要。我们开发了一个通用统计框架和Python包（llmReproScore），用于量化LLM输出的重复性和再现性。参照美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的术语，我们的框架沿两个维度建立了四项指标来量化LLM的重复性和再现性：语义和内部。语义指标量化LLM生成输出在含义上的变异性，而内部指标量化token生成确定性方面的变异性。我们验证了这些指标，并作为一个示例性用例，将其应用于使用美国医师执照考试（US Medical Licensing Examination）题目和来自未诊断疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）的90个真实世界罕见病病例、跨LLM和提示策略生成的诊断推理输出。验证结果显示，语义评分与人工评分一致（重复性的Spearman ρ = 0.88，再现性的Spearman ρ = 0.66），并确认内部指标捕捉了token生成确定性的变异性。在示例性用例中，LLM重复性总体上与准确性无关，提示LLM输出变异性和准确性捕捉的是模型性能的不同维度。所提出的指标可用于表征LLM输出变异性，并系统比较模型、提示和生成设置。这些比较可为基于重复性和再现性更严格地选择LLM配置提供依据。我们开发并验证了用于量化LLM输出变异性的可推广指标。所提出的指标可以补充基于准确性的评估，为实验设计提供信息，并支持更严格地比较和选择模型、提示及生成设置。

abstract: Background: Although direct-acting antivirals have transformed hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, 25-30% of active infections in Spain remain undiagnosed. We aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning model to identify undiagnosed HCV infection using only data already recorded within the health system. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective, population-based cohort study using the Andalusian Population Health Database (BPS). Individuals diagnosed with HCV between 2017 and 2024 (n=25,028) were matched, up to 10:1, to controls by birth year, sex, and health district. An Explainable Boosting Machine was trained on 2017-2022 data, with a threshold set in a 2023 validation set to guarantee [≥]60% sensitivity, then evaluated unmodified in an independent, non-matched, population-representative 2024 sample approximating real-world screening. Predictors comprised chronic-disease diagnoses and laboratory summary statistics recorded [≥]30 days before the index date; age and sex were excluded as matching variables. Predictors reflecting socioeconomic proxies or matching artefacts (pharmaceutical co-payment category, a zone-level deprivation index) were removed after explainability review. Results: In the independent test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.837 (0.826 in validation), sensitivity 63.5%, specificity 91.8%, positive predictive value 7.0%, and negative predictive value 99.6%. Leading predictors were minimum alanine aminotransferase, HIV infection, dependence on non-tobacco substances, and platelet-count statistics, forming a clinically coherent, laboratory- and comorbidity-driven profile. Conclusion: An explainable model built exclusively from routine electronic health record data can identify undiagnosed HCV infection with discrimination comparable to previously published tools, evaluated under conditions approximating true population prevalence. Bias-auditing was feasible without sacrificing interpretability, supporting a scalable, equity-conscious instrument for the final phase of HCV elimination.
zh_abstract: 【背景】尽管直接抗病毒药物已改变丙型肝炎病毒（hepatitis C virus, HCV）治疗格局，西班牙25-30%的活动性感染仍未确诊。我们旨在开发并验证一种可解释的机器学习模型，仅使用卫生系统内已记录的数据来识别未确诊的HCV感染。【方法】我们使用安达卢西亚人口健康数据库（Andalusian Population Health Database, BPS）开展了一项回顾性、基于人群的队列研究。2017年至2024年间诊断为HCV的个体（n=25,028）按出生年份、性别和卫生区与对照进行最多10:1匹配。在2017-2022年数据上训练可解释提升机（Explainable Boosting Machine），并在2023年验证集中设定阈值以保证灵敏度≥60%，随后在一个独立的、非匹配的、代表人群的2024年样本中不作修改地评估，该样本近似真实世界筛查。预测变量包括索引日期前≥30天记录的慢性病诊断和实验室汇总统计量；年龄和性别作为匹配变量被排除。在可解释性审查后，反映社会经济替代指标或匹配伪影的预测变量（药品共付类别、区域层面剥夺指数）被移除。【结果】在独立测试集中，模型达到AUC 0.837（验证集0.826）、灵敏度63.5%、特异度91.8%、阳性预测值7.0%、阴性预测值99.6%。主要预测变量为丙氨酸氨基转移酶最小值、HIV感染、对非烟草物质的依赖以及血小板计数统计量，形成具有临床一致性、由实验室和合并症驱动的特征谱。【结论】一个完全基于常规电子健康记录数据构建的可解释模型能够识别未确诊的HCV感染，其区分能力与既往已发表工具相当，并在近似真实人群患病率的条件下评估。偏倚审计在不牺牲可解释性的情况下可行，支持一种可扩展、具有公平意识的工具用于HCV消除的最后阶段。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Effective communication between clinicians and patients plays an important role in the successful delivery of health care. In geriatric medicine, where multimorbidity, polypharmacy, and functional limitations often make treatment plans complex, AI simplifications of clinical reports into patient-friendly language offer a promising way to improve communication. This study investigated whether AI could generate patient-friendly simplifications of outpatient reports that were comparable to those authored by human experts. Gemma-3-27B-it, an instruction fine-tuned open-source large language model (LLM) by Google, was used, and few-shot prompting was applied to enable the generation of patient-friendly simplifications of 64 deidentified geriatric outpatient reports written in German while preserving clinical meaning. LLM-generated simplifications were compared with those produced by 2 medical experts in a blinded evaluation. Quality was assessed using three approaches: (1) embedding-based semantic similarity to the original report, (2) blinded expert review by 2 clinicians, and (3) review by patient representatives, with the latter 2 using a standardized Likert-scale questionnaire. AI-generated simplifications were comparable to geriatrician-authored simplifications regarding semantic similarity (P=.02) and were preferred by patient representatives (P<.001) as well as one expert reviewer (P=.001). Expert reviewers perceived physician-authored simplifications as more complete (P<.001), a finding that correlated with text length (P<.001). This study demonstrates the feasibility of using LLMs via few-shot prompting to simplify medical reports for improved perceived patient comprehension in geriatric care. Future prospective studies should examine whether such AI-driven simplifications positively impact objective health-related outcomes, adherence, and patient engagement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 临床医生与患者之间的有效沟通在成功提供医疗保健中发挥重要作用。在老年医学中，多病共存、多重用药和功能受限常使治疗计划复杂化，AI将临床报告简化为患者友好语言为改善沟通提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究调查了AI能否生成与人类专家撰写的简化版本相当的患者友好型门诊报告简化版本。使用由Google开发、经指令微调的开源大语言模型（LLM）Gemma-3-27B-it，并应用少样本提示（few-shot prompting），以生成64份以德语书写的去标识化老年门诊报告的患者友好型简化版本，同时保留临床含义。在盲法评估中，将LLM生成的简化版本与2名医学专家生成的简化版本进行比较。质量通过三种方法评估：（1）基于嵌入的与原始报告的语义相似度；（2）由2名临床医生进行盲法专家评审；（3）由患者代表评审，后两者使用标准化Likert量表问卷。AI生成的简化版本在语义相似度方面与老年科医生撰写的简化版本相当（P=.02），并且更受患者代表（P<.001）以及一名专家评审者（P=.001）偏好。专家评审者认为医生撰写的简化版本更完整（P<.001），这一发现与文本长度相关（P<.001）。本研究证明通过少样本提示使用LLM简化医疗报告以改善老年护理中患者感知理解程度的可行性。未来前瞻性研究应检验此类AI驱动的简化是否对客观健康相关结局、依从性和患者参与度产生积极影响。

abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] 医学影像中的人工智能正从任务特定算法转向可适应基础模型（foundation models, FMs）和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于MRI仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要整合跨多个序列的多参数、容积成像与临床背景。本系统综述评估了35项关于MRI中单模态FMs和多模态VLMs的研究，总结了新兴架构、下游应用及临床转化面临的挑战。当前研究集中于神经影像，诊断分类是最成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅性强，仍受限于临床保真度差。更广泛采用受到MRI采集异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限以及缺乏以安全性为重点的评估指标等因素的阻碍。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更强整合、稳健的评估框架以及改进的模型可解释性。

title: Scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification for Cancer Histopathology: Calibrated Uncertainty Under Distribution Shift
zh_title: 可扩展贝叶斯高斯过程用于癌症病理分类
summary: 预印本提出基于冻结病理基础模型嵌入的可扩展贝叶斯高斯过程分类框架，在约30万训练点上实现HMC后验采样，并考察分布偏移下的不确定性校准。
key_points: 在Phikon冻结嵌入上做低秩高斯过程分类
RPCholesky加速与HMC非中心参数化采样
关注跨院分布偏移下的过度自信问题

reason: 方法有新意、规模可观，但预印本且未见外部验证或代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for clinical deployment of cancer diagnosis models, yet neural networks and variational Gaussian process methods can produce overconfident predictions, particularly under the distribution shifts that arise when models trained at one hospital are applied at another. We present a scalable Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification (GPC) framework that operates on frozen pathology foundation model embeddings (Phikon) and combines accelerated Randomly Pivoted Cholesky (RPCholesky) for low-rank kernel factorization, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) with non-centered parameterization for posterior sampling, and a pivots-as-inducing-points scheme for prediction. This makes HMC posterior sampling in the low-rank latent representation tractable at N approximately 300,000 training points, enabling HC-based low-rank GPC on substantially larger datasets than prior MCMC-based demonstrations. We evaluate on two histopathology benchmarks for breast cancer metastasis detection: PCam and CAMELYON17-WILDS, where the latter tests calibration under hospital-level distribution shift. Compared to stochastic variational GP and neural network baselines, our method improves calibration and predictive performance - reducing expected calibration error by up to 88% and false negative rate by up to 90% - with the largest gains appearing under distribution shift, suggesting that HMC-based posterior sampling provides more trustworthy uncertainty estimates for cross-site pathology classification.
zh_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于癌症诊断模型的临床部署至关重要，然而神经网络和变分高斯过程方法可能产生过度自信的预测，尤其是在一家医院训练的模型应用于另一家医院时出现的分布偏移下。我们提出一种可扩展的贝叶斯高斯过程分类（Bayesian Gaussian Process Classification, GPC）框架，该框架在冻结的病理基础模型嵌入（Phikon）上运行，并结合用于低秩核分解的加速随机主元Cholesky（Randomly Pivoted Cholesky, RPCholesky）、采用非中心参数化的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, HMC）进行后验采样，以及以主元作为诱导点的预测方案。这使得在约300,000个训练点规模下，对低秩潜在表示进行HMC后验采样变得可行，从而能够在比以往基于MCMC的演示大得多的数据集上实现基于HC的低秩GPC。我们在两个用于乳腺癌转移检测的组织病理学基准上评估：PCam和CAMELYON17-WILDS，其中后者检验医院级分布偏移下的校准。与随机变分GP和神经网络基线相比，我们的方法改善了校准和预测性能——将预期校准误差最多降低88%，将假阴性率最多降低90%——最大增益出现在分布偏移下，表明基于HMC的后验采样为跨站点病理分类提供了更可信的不确定性估计。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: zhaoxiaohui; conditions: Cancer, Malignant Neoplasms, Radiotherapy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 62; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Radiotherapy, a cornerstone of comprehensive cancer treatment, relies heavily on clinician expertise for target volume contouring and treatment planning. Consequently, clinical practice is often constrained by procedural bottlenecks, inter-observer variability, and prolonged iterative feedback cycles. Although current artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated progress in automated contouring, key limitations persist, including insufficient integration of multimodal clinical text, a lack of closed-loop dosimetric feedback, and limited generalizability across complex cancer types. This study aims to develop and validate RATA (Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant), a novel large model system powered by a collaborative multi-agent architecture. Driven by Large Language Model (LLM) decision engines, RATA processes pathological imaging, electronic health records (EHR), and multimodal medical data to construct a end-to-end, fully automated closed-loop pipeline encompassing "target contouring, plan design, dosimetric evaluation, and reflective refinement." Innovatively breaking through traditional unidirectional radiotherapy workflows, the system establishes a dosimetric feedback-driven adaptive iteration mechanism, leveraging dose distribution outcomes to guide multi-agent dynamic fine-tuning of target volumes, thereby mimicking the collaborative clinical logic between senior radiation oncologists and medical physicists. For validation, this study adopts a multi-center, three-stage clinical validation framework-comprising multi-center retrospective validation, human-AI collaborative efficacy assessment, and a prospective randomized controlled trial (RCT)-to comprehensively evaluate the system's performance in improving contouring precision, mitigating experience-dependent disparities across clinician seniority, and reducing total workflow processing time. Implementation of the RATA platform holds potential to eliminate redundant operational steps, enabling a minute-level "scan-to-treat" response. Furthermore, its natural language interaction interface optimizes human-AI collaboration and substantially reduces clinical workload. Overall, this study not only establishes a standardized, intelligent assistance paradigm for precision radiation oncology but also provides essential evidence-based support and technological foundations for the clinical translation of multimodal AI in complex cancer management.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：zhaoxiaohui；疾病：Cancer（癌症）、Malignant Neoplasms（恶性肿瘤）、Radiotherapy（放疗）；类型：INTERVENTIONAL（干预性）；分期：NA（不适用）；入组人数：62；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 放疗是综合癌症治疗的基石，其靶区勾画和治疗计划高度依赖临床医生的专业经验。因此，临床实践常受流程瓶颈、观察者间差异和漫长迭代反馈周期的制约。尽管当前人工智能（AI）模型在自动勾画方面已取得进展，但仍存在关键局限，包括多模态临床文本整合不足、缺乏闭环剂量学反馈，以及在复杂癌症类型间泛化能力有限。本研究旨在开发并验证RATA（Radiotherapy Treatment Multi-Agent Assistant，放疗治疗多智能体助手），这是一种由协作式多智能体架构驱动的新型大模型系统。RATA以大语言模型（LLM）决策引擎为驱动，处理病理影像、电子健康记录（EHR）和多模态医学数据，以构建涵盖“靶区勾画、计划设计、剂量学评估和反思性优化”的端到端、全自动闭环流程。该系统创新性地突破传统单向放疗工作流程，建立剂量学反馈驱动的自适应迭代机制，利用剂量分布结果指导多智能体对靶区进行动态微调，从而模拟资深放射肿瘤科医生与医学物理师之间的协作临床逻辑。在验证方面，本研究采用多中心、三阶段临床验证框架——包括多中心回顾性验证、人机协作疗效评估和前瞻性随机对照试验（RCT）——以全面评估该系统在提高勾画精度、减轻不同资历临床医生之间经验依赖差异以及缩短总工作流程处理时间方面的性能。RATA平台的实施有望消除冗余操作步骤，实现分钟级“扫描到治疗”（scan-to-treat）响应。此外，其自然语言交互界面优化了人机协作，并大幅降低临床工作量。总体而言，本研究不仅为精准放射肿瘤学建立了标准化智能辅助范式，还为多模态AI在复杂癌症管理中的临床转化提供了必要的循证支持和技术基础。

abstract: Using electronic health record (EHR) data to answer clinical research questions is challenging. It requires understanding the research question, finding relevant information across different sources, and combining that information to produce meaningful results. We developed an agentic large language model (LLM) pipeline that decomposes investigator-authored requests into source-specific tasks, generates and executes SQL on EHR, integrates structured and unstructured EHR evidence, and applies study-specific clinical note adjudication. We evaluated this workflow against data analyst-identified cohorts across 50 pediatric orthopedic clinical data query requests. Of these, 43 were included in manual-review-adjusted performance analyses. The median adjusted positive predictive value, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach, and corresponding F1 score were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.88-0.98), 0.92 (95% CI, 0.90-0.95) and 0.90 (95% CI, 0.87-0.94), respectively. These findings support the feasibility of translating natural-language research intent into executable, autonomous multi-stage EHR workflows.
zh_abstract: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据回答临床研究问题具有挑战性。这需要理解研究问题、在不同来源中查找相关信息，并整合这些信息以产生有意义的结果。我们开发了一个智能体式大语言模型（LLM）流水线，将研究者编写的请求分解为针对特定数据源的任务，生成并在 EHR 上执行 SQL，整合结构化与非结构化 EHR 证据，并应用研究特定的临床笔记判定。我们在 50 项儿科骨科临床数据查询请求中，将该工作流程与数据分析师识别的队列进行对比评估。其中 43 项被纳入经人工复核调整的性能分析。调整后的阳性预测值中位数、两种方法任一识别患者中的敏感性及相应 F1 分数分别为 0.93（95% CI，0.88-0.98）、0.92（95% CI，0.90-0.95）和 0.90（95% CI，0.87-0.94）。这些发现支持将自然语言研究意图转化为可执行、自主的多阶段 EHR 工作流程的可行性。

title: LeadWeaver: Topology-Aware Masked-Lead Modeling for Robust 12-Lead ECG Diagnosis
zh_title: LeadWeaver：面向缺失与设备漂移导联的心电诊断
summary: 预印本提出拓扑感知心电表示模型，用生理导联图与掩码导联潜空间补全应对导联缺失、损坏或设备差异。
key_points: 固定加可学习的生理导联图耦合各导联
以潜空间补全替代波形合成
可靠性路由决定诊断所依赖的导联
在PTB-XL与CPSC类设置上评估
reason: 针对导联缺失鲁棒性的新方法，公开数据集基线对比，尚无外部验证
abstract: Clinical electrocardiography is organized as a structured set of correlated leads, yet most neural ECG classifiers assume that all twelve leads are present, correctly ordered, and acquired under the same device conditions at training and deployment. We propose LeadWeaver, a topology-aware ECG representation model designed for diagnosis under missing, corrupted, or device-shifted leads. LeadWeaver represents each lead as a temporal token stream, couples leads through a fixed-plus-learned physiological lead graph, and performs masked-lead latent completion rather than waveform synthesis. A reliability router estimates which observed leads should dominate each diagnostic decision, while a consistency objective aligns complete-lead and incomplete-lead predictions. We evaluate the model on PTB-XL and CPSC-style settings using complete-input diagnosis, arbitrary missing-lead subsets, lead corruption, cross-dataset transfer, calibration, and selective prediction. The central hypothesis is that robust ECG diagnosis requires explicitly modeling both inter-lead topology and uncertainty about unavailable evidence, rather than treating missing channels as zero-valued inputs.
zh_abstract: 临床心电图被组织为一组结构化的相关导联，然而大多数神经 ECG 分类器假设所有十二个导联均存在、顺序正确，并且在训练和部署时处于相同设备条件下。我们提出 LeadWeaver，一种拓扑感知的 ECG 表示模型，旨在用于导联缺失、损坏或设备偏移情况下的诊断。LeadWeaver 将每个导联表示为时间 token 流，通过固定加可学习的生理导联图耦合导联，并执行掩码导联的潜在补全而非波形合成。可靠性路由器估计哪些观测导联应在每个诊断决策中占主导，而一致性目标使完整导联和不完整导联的预测对齐。我们在 PTB-XL 和 CPSC 风格设置上评估该模型，使用完整输入诊断、任意缺失导联子集、导联损坏、跨数据集迁移、校准和选择性预测。核心假设是，稳健的 ECG 诊断需要显式建模导联间拓扑结构以及对不可用证据的不确定性，而不是将缺失通道视为零值输入。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Maryland, Baltimore; conditions: Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection (CLABSI), Bacteremia, Bloodstream Infections; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 30; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Infection prevention and control programs at US hospitals perform surveillance to detect and publicly report hospital-onset central line-associated bloodstream infections (CLABSI) using standards set by CDC's National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). Because this process requires time-consuming review of the medical record by dedicated infection preventionists, VA has developed a generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool that applies the NHSN CLABSI standard to clinical data from the medical record. In this quality improvement initiative, we will evaluate the tool as it is implemented operationally across a cohort of VA medical centers in 3 randomized waves. The purpose of this evaluation is (1) to determine whether the tool reduces the time required for CLABSI surveillance, (2) to assess the objectivity and trustworthiness of the tool from the perspective of infection preventionists, and (3) to detect patient safety events.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：马里兰大学巴尔的摩分校（University of Maryland, Baltimore）；疾病：中心静脉导管相关血流感染（Central Line-Associated Bloodstream Infection, CLABSI）、菌血症、血流感染；类型：干预性；阶段：NA；入组人数：30；状态：尚未招募] 美国医院的感染预防与控制项目使用美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）国家医疗安全网络（National Healthcare Safety Network, NHSN）制定的标准进行监测，以发现并公开报告医院发生的中心静脉导管相关血流感染（CLABSI）。由于该过程需要专职感染预防人员耗时审查病历，美国退伍军人事务部（VA）开发了一种生成式人工智能（AI）工具，可将NHSN CLABSI标准应用于病历中的临床数据。在这项质量改进项目中，我们将随着该工具在一组VA医疗中心以3个随机批次投入实际运行来对其进行评估。本评估的目的是：（1）确定该工具是否减少CLABSI监测所需时间；（2）从感染预防人员角度评估该工具的客观性和可信度；（3）检测患者安全事件。

title: Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis

summary: arXiv预印本比较LBP、Gabor、小波、CNN等多种特征与五种分类器组合，用于MRI脑肿瘤识别。

reason: 预印本，特征组合式方法，仅报告指标无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. Code: https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection
zh_abstract: 医学影像的最新创新显著改进了脑肿瘤识别，优于受低分辨率、辐射暴露和对比度受限困扰的传统诊断方法。磁共振成像（MRI）由于其高分辨率和非侵入性，在精确和准确的肿瘤表征中至关重要。本研究探讨了多种特征表示方案之间的协同作用，例如局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度级游程长度矩阵（Gray-Level Run Length Matrix），以及五种学习算法，即：k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP结合SVC和CNN获得了高特异度和准确率，使其成为基于MRI的肿瘤诊断的一种有前景的方法。为进一步研究LBP的贡献，使用卡方检验和p值检验进行统计分析，以确认LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别的显著影响。此外，使用SHAP分析识别分类中最重要的特征。在小数据集中，CNN获得了97.8%的准确率，而SVC产生了98.06%的准确率。在后续分析中，还使用大型基准数据集评估学习算法的性能，以研究所提出模型的泛化能力。CNN达到最高准确率98.9%，其次是SVC的96.7%。这些结果凸显了CNN在自动化、高精度肿瘤诊断中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection
